system.description: Anything within reach is a weapon. As a single action (◈), snatch up a loose object (a gin bottle, a chair leg, a cobble) and attack with it: a melee attack for d6 with the finesse trait, or a throw (20') for d4. The object breaks. If you smash a lit lamp or lantern over a foe, it also takes d4 persistent fire damage, and that light goes out. This attack is Risky.
